Method of Attack: Relay web traffic by installing a SOCKS proxy server on infected IoT devices
Engaged in email spam campaigns using infected devices to send spam emails via remote SMTP servers
Infects devices by taking over IoT equipment still running default credentials
Impacted Systems: IoT devices running various architectures such as x86, MIPS, MIPSEL, PowerPC, ARM, Superh, Motorola 68000, and SPARC
Attack Vector: Compromise of IoT devices with default credentials
